projects.name: Multi-Agent Generator – Python Library | Creator & Maintainer
details: Multi-Agent Generator – Python Library | Creator & Maintainer
• Developed a Python library that translates plain English instructions into fully configured multi -agent AI teams.
• Implemented LLM-agnostic support using LiteLLM for compatibility with GPT, Claude, Llama, and other models.
• Enabled 6+ agentic frameworks for flexible multi-agent architecture design.
• Integrated automatic code generation and workflow visualization for streamlined development.
• Achieved 4,000+ downloads within six months and earned 100+ GitHub stars, reflecting strong community adoption.
• Published on PyPI for easy installation and distribution.

projects.name: Autonomous AI Security Auditor
details: Autonomous AI Security Auditor
Built an autonomous AI security auditor for AWS Bedrock, leveraging Bedrock Agents, Lambda orchestration, EventBridge -driven
scheduled scans, and CloudTrail analysis to detect policy misconfigurations, insecure prompts, data -leak risks, and adversarial

vulnerabilities across GenAI pipelines. Implemented S3-based audit logging, IAM configuration analysis, and DynamoDB-backed model– policy mapping to ensure enterprise-grade compliance, traceability, and safety.
